info.title: Markdown Logic Platform API
info.description:
Authenticated platform API: teams, projects, documents, folders, publications
(snapshots and releases), renders, shares, credentials and billing.

**Authentication is OAuth 2.1 only.** Send an access token issued by
`https://auth.markdownlogic.com` as `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`. Session
tokens and `mdl_` access keys are no longer issued and are rejected. Earlier
versions of this document described them after they had already stopped working.

Every operation records the scope its gate requires in `x-required-scope`.
A client credential may additionally be BOUND to one team
(`oauth_clients.team_id`), in which case every request naming another team is
refused with 403 regardless of what its owner can reach.

The public share surface (`/s/**`, `/share/project/**`) is unauthenticated and
is not described here.

match.description: Which arm of the query found this document: exact/BM25 text match, semantic/vector similarity, or a chunk of each.

highlights.description: [start, end) character offsets into `text` where a query term was found, merged where they overlap. Each is a position to mark, never a ranking signal.

flags.description: Caveats about this result: `partially_indexed` (only part of the document was indexed), `changed_since_indexed` (edited after indexing, so its passages are withheld rather than shown as stale text), `endpoint_title_only` (an endpoint document, indexed by title only).

oldestPendingAt.description: When the oldest pending document was queued, or null when nothing is pending.

sensitivity.description: GET only, and only for a team that blocks sensitive sharing: how many documents are withheld from search because no sensitivity verdict covers their current content. Counts only. The two findings ABOUT content (`sensitiveRepoDocuments`, `indeterminateRepoDocuments`) stay in the sysadmin diagnostics and are deliberately not published here.

unknownRepoDocuments.description: Repository documents awaiting a verdict. The hourly catch-up drains this one on its own.

unknownProjectDocuments.description: Project documents with no verdict covering their current content. A verdict is written when a document is read or shared, so nothing drains this in the background.

notIndexed.description: A page of at most 50 not-indexed rows. This is a SAMPLE, not the full list; see `notIndexedTotal` for the real count.

unknownProjectDocuments.description: Project documents with no sensitivity verdict yet. get.summary: Preview a Stripe sync (sysadmin): the plan feature text that would be written to Stripe, the catalog rows that would change, the Stripe mode, the environment and a `previewHash`. Writes nothing. When the Stripe key does not match the environment it does not call Stripe: it answers 200 with `applyAllowed` false, a `refusal` and no `previewHash`. 502 when Stripe answers with a server error.

200.description: The preview. A key in the wrong mode is a 200 with applyAllowed false and the reason in refusal.

stripeMode.description: The mode of the key and of the objects Stripe listed: live, test, mixed or not set.

applyAllowed.description: False when the key or the listed objects are in the wrong mode for this environment.

refusal.description: The reason code when applyAllowed is false, otherwise null.

previewHash.description: Quote it in the apply. Null when there is no plan.

post.summary: Apply a previewed Stripe sync (sysadmin). `{ "previewHash": string, "environment": string }`, both from the preview. Writes Stripe first, then the catalog, and is audited. A partial write answers 200 with `complete` false. 400 when the hash is missing or malformed, 409 when Stripe or the catalog changed since the preview, 422 when the environment or the Stripe key mode does not match, 429 when throttled, 502 when Stripe answers with a server error.

previewHash.description: The previewHash of the preview the operator reviewed.

environment.description: The environment the operator confirmed. Refused with 422 unless it is the one this worker serves.

200.description: The apply ran. When complete is false a write stopped part-way and the response says what was not written.

complete.description: False when a Stripe write or the catalogue write stopped part-way. Not an error status: read the lists.

400.description: The body is not JSON or previewHash is missing or malformed (preview-hash-required).

409.description: stale-preview: Stripe or the catalogue changed since the preview. The body carries no hash; preview again.

422.description: environment-mismatch, or a key or listing in the wrong mode for the environment (stripe-mode-mismatch, stripe-key-unrecognised). Nothing was written.

429.description: Rate limited: either this route’s own limiter, or Stripe answered 429 (stripe-rate-limited).

post.summary: Pull the plan catalog from Stripe now, without a preview (sysadmin). Never writes to Stripe. Deactivates prices Stripe no longer lists, but never takes the last price of a sold plan off sale: that price, and a price whose product stopped naming its sold plan, is reported as `withheld` and left as it was. Only the previewed apply at `POST /admin/billing/stripe-sync` can do that. 422 when the Stripe key mode does not match the environment, 502 when Stripe answers with a server error.
